audit.why: Early lane belongs to Sylas (W heal-lunge, Q poke, level-6 Hijack of Hemoplague); Vladimir takes over from first item. EVEN 5.5/10 fits the 52% WR.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..5].side are a blanket 'Skill' while content win[] and the packet chart give Sylas levels 1-6 and Vladimir from first item — the page renders two answers.
audit.why: Content chart is grounded: Kingslayer (12s→6s) healing beats early Transfusion trades, Hijack steals Hemoplague at 6; Riftmaker flips the drain war and pool answers the 13s Abduct engage.
audit.corrected: phases[0..5].side aligned to content win[]; whys and ratings rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text labels Chain Lash as (E) and calls Petricite Burst '(Q)' with 'sustain' — Chain Lash is Q, Petricite Burst is his PASSIVE and it grants empowered autos/attack speed, not sustain (his sustain is Kingslayer W). spikes[2].text says 'Pool his Chain Lash pull' — Chain Lash has no pull; the pull is Abduct (E recast). whys[1] repeats the Petricite-sustain error.
audit.why: Riot kit: Q Chain Lash (10-6s, 775, slow), W Kingslayer (12-6s, 400, dash+heal vs champions), E Abscond/Abduct (13-9s, dash then chain pull, projectile), R Hijack (80/55/30s, steals ults), P Petricite Burst (empowered chain autos + attack speed).
audit.corrected: Slots and mechanics corrected in spikes[0], spikes[2], whys[1]; cooldown numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: Abscond 13s rank 1, Kingslayer 12→6s, Hijack 80/55/30s are the windows that decide when to step up.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Lint findings; bodies rewritten to explain their own titles.

Key hidden points now on-page: Abduct's chain is a projectile-class pull that Sanguine Pool's untargetability denies; a stolen Hemoplague heals Sylas off your team — anti-heal timing matters both ways (missingInteractions: Kingslayer sustain). Whether pool drops a stolen Hemoplague mark is not in the kit text — not asserted.
No kit-visible 26.15 movement asserted; not verified against patch notes.

edits.before: Q-farm and nothing else — your level 1 is among the worst mid. Give CS you can't Q safely and smile about it.
edits.after: His Chain Lash plus Petricite autos out-trade your level 1 — Q-farm at max range and give CS you cannot take safely.

edits.before: Still surviving. Q on cooldown when free, pool saved for the jungler you haven't seen yet.
edits.after: Kingslayer arrives — his lunge heals off you, so every trade you start pays into his health bar.

edits.before: E charges join the pattern: Q-E wave contact trades start mattering. Health is your mana — spend like an accountant.
edits.after: Full combo online: Abduct pull into Kingslayer heal beats any trade you start — respect the dash-chain threat range.

edits.before: The crimson rush timing — Q empowers every third-ish cast and the sustain war starts tilting your way.
edits.after: He keeps winning the poke-and-sustain war — Kingslayer's cooldown keeps falling while your Qs only narrow it.

edits.before: Hemoplague online — the all-in inverts: Q-E-R-E with ignite kills most mids who thought they were winning.
edits.after: He steals Hemoplague at 6 and his Kingslayer heal wins the mirrored all-in — do not test it without your jungler.

edits.before: Riftmaker timing: every trade heals more than it costs. Extended fights are now donations to your health bar.
edits.after: Riftmaker flips it — you out-drain his combo, and pool answers the Abduct pull that starts his kill windows.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Sanguine Pool has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: Abscond/Abduct is 13s at rank 1 — with the dash down he has no way onto you, so that window is yours. Kingslayer falls from 12s to 6s: extended trades feed his healing. Hijack is 80s early — once he burns your stolen Hemoplague, your own R wins the next fight.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, E-charge as he steps to answer, release and walk — the trade costs him HP and pays yours.
edits.after: His Chain Lash costs 55 mana and your Transfusion costs nothing — match his chip cast for cast and the war is even.

edits.before: Pooling his poke and then eating the real engage at half HP with nothing — the pool is a combo-breaker, not a flinch reflex.
edits.after: Overextended with W on its 28-second early cooldown, his Abduct chain-pull is a death sentence — hug the wave until pool is back.

edits.before: Sylas wins by landing Abscond / Abduct, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Sylas wins by pulling in with Abduct, healing through your trades with Kingslayer, and stealing Hemoplague at 6.

edits.before: At 2 his Petricite Burst sustain outlasts your early Transfusion.
edits.after: At 2 his Kingslayer heal-lunge outlasts your early Transfusion.

edits.before: Sylas bullies early: his Chain Lash (E) into Kingslayer (W) heal-and-execute combo out-trades your Transfusion, and his Petricite Burst (Q) sustains him through the poke war you can't win yet.
edits.after: Sylas bullies early: his Chain Lash (Q) into Kingslayer (W) heal-and-lunge combo out-trades your Transfusion, and his Petricite Burst empowered autos win the trades you can't dodge yet.

edits.before: Vladimir turns it: Riftmaker/Rylai's plus your Q-E DPS out-sustains his combo, and you can Sanguine Pool his Chain Lash pull so his all-in whiffs.
edits.after: Vladimir turns it: Riftmaker/Rylai's plus your Q-E DPS out-sustains his combo, and you can Sanguine Pool his Abduct pull so his all-in whiffs.

notes: Packet defect flags the 5/7-Sylas chart against the 52.43% Vladimir WR; the chart still holds — Vladimir's WR is post-item scaling while Sylas owns the early trading pattern. Content win[] untouched; full sides aligned to it. whys[2]/whys[3] say 'heal-execute pattern' — Kingslayer's kit text does not say execute; left alone (borderline, small field) and noted here. sectionsMissing: breakdown.carry, breakdown.wave, ahead, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.early remain structurally templated; nothing Sylas-specific verifiable enough to ground without inventing.
